addr: # VETTE.EXE (DOS 1.1 EN) symbol map. Source of truth for naming; applied to Ghidra by re/ghidra_scripts/VetteApplySymbols.java.
# kind: func | data | label. Data sizes are noted in comments (b=byte w=word d=dword).

name: start
comment: Real entry point (after EXEPACK). Sets DS=124Ah and runs init and the main menu loop.

name: detect_cpu_class
comment: push sp/pop ax 8088 test, then idiv loop for 0x124 PIT ticks (~1 s). Returns AX 0=8088/slow 1=medium 2=fast; fast clears cs:0E26/0E27.

name: cpu_slow_flag_a
comment: b; 0xFF unless detect_cpu_class says fast. Copied to mirror_off (124A:2AC7) at race start: slow CPUs start with the rear-view mirror off.

name: cpu_slow_flag_b
comment: b; 0xFF unless detect_cpu_class says fast. Copied to windows_off (124A:2ABE) at race start: slow CPUs start with downtown building windows off.

name: game_outer_loop
comment: Outer loop: menus / garage / race setup. Re-entered from 3009:008A 00B2 0618.

name: frame_loop
comment: Per-frame loop head (back-edge 3009:061B). See re/notes/02-frame-loop.md.

name: video_set_mode_ega_0e
comment: INT 10h mode 0Eh (EGA 640x200x16) for menus and screens; pages A000/A400. The race uses mode 0Dh (video_set_mode_ega_0d).

name: video_page_seg_a
comment: w; A000h

name: video_page_seg_b
comment: w; A400h in mode 0Eh, A200h in mode 0Dh (race).

name: frame_measure_rate
comment: Inside the main frame loop: xchg pit_ticks with 0 -> elapsed (min 1); frame_rate = round(291/elapsed), min 4.

name: frame_rate
comment: w; frames per second measured each frame. The simulation scales per-frame motion by this.

name: race_ticks
comment: d; accumulated PIT ticks (291.3 Hz) for the race clock.

name: race_seconds
comment: w; race_ticks / 0x123 (291). The real rate is 291.27 Hz so the clock runs ~0.1% slow.

name: race_clock_tick
comment: race_clock_update then race_ticks += pit_ticks (before the frame loop resets pit_ticks).

name: race_clock_update
comment: race_seconds = (race_ticks + pit_ticks) / 291.

name: timer_init
comment: Sound init then PIT ch0 divisor 0x1000 (291.3 Hz) then installs ISRs.

name: timer_install_isrs
comment: Hooks INT 08h -> int08_timer and INT 1Ch -> int1c_joystick_buttons.

name: timer_restore
comment: Restores INT 08h/1Ch and PIT divisor 0 (18.2 Hz).

name: int08_timer
comment: IRQ0 at 291.3 Hz: ++pit_ticks; every 4th IRQ runs timer_work (72.8 Hz).

name: timer_work
comment: 72.8 Hz: snd_engine_pitch_tick + snd_seq_tick; every 4th call chains to BIOS INT 08h (keeps 18.2 Hz time of day).

name: pit_set_ch0_divisor
comment: BX = divisor (0 = 65536).

name: pit_ticks
comment: w; incremented at 291.3 Hz. Read-and-reset by the frame loop.

name: work_ticks
comment: w; incremented at 72.8 Hz.

name: old_int1c
comment: d

name: old_int08
comment: d

name: int1c_joystick_buttons
comment: 18.2 Hz: reads joystick buttons (port 201h bits 4-5) into joy_buttons.

name: joy_buttons
comment: b

name: snd_play
comment: AX = sequence pointer (cs-relative). Starts playback if sound_enabled.

name: snd_stop
comment: Speaker off and points the sequence at the idle sequence 92C0.

name: spk_set_divisor
comment: Speaker on, PIT ch2 mode 3 (B6h), divisor CX.

name: snd_seq_tick
comment: 72.8 Hz sequence step. Entries are {w duration, w divisor}: divisor -1 = rest, duration 0 = jump back by divisor bytes, duration -1 = end.

name: snd_engine_set_target
comment: Engine-note slide direction from engine_speed vs previous value.

name: snd_engine_pitch_tick
comment: 72.8 Hz engine-note pitch slide (divisor at cs:92A8 limited to 0x1400..0xB000).

name: sound_enabled
comment: b

name: snd_seq_engine
comment: Engine-note sequence (divisor slides in place).

name: snd_engine_slide
comment: w; bit15 = slide down. Low bits = rate.

name: snd_seq_count
comment: w

name: snd_seq_ptr
comment: w

name: engine_speed
comment: w; player engine rpm in units of 100 rpm (= 2D61). Written by 60D7 (6131); 60/0 by garage rev sequence.

name: kbd_install
comment: Saves INT 09h into cs:0000 and installs kbd_isr (far; called from start).

name: kbd_restore
comment: Restores the original INT 09h.

name: kbd_isr
comment: INT 09h keyboard handler (reads port 60h).

name: old_int09
comment: d

name: kbd_state
comment: 11 words of key state written by kbd_isr.

name: kbd_clear_state
comment: Zeroes kbd_state and cs:003C.

name: video_set_mode_ega_0d
comment: INT 10h mode 0Dh (EGA 320x200x16, 40 bytes/row) for the race view (called at 0155). Pages A000/A200; cs:926A=1.

name: draw_page
comment: w; current back page 0/1 (toggled by page_flip_select).

name: page_crtc_start
comment: 2 w; CRTC start address shown while drawing page 0/1 (2000h, 0).

name: page_draw_seg
comment: 2 w; draw segment per page (A000, A200).

name: backbuf_seg
comment: w; current back-buffer segment that all race drawing targets.

name: vram_store_seg
comment: w; A400 off-screen VRAM holding the three horizon panoramas (latch-copy source).

name: page_flip_select
comment: Toggles draw_page; backbuf_seg = page_draw_seg[page]; returns BX = CRTC start of the page just drawn.

name: crtc_set_start_vsync
comment: Waits for vertical retrace; writes CRTC regs 0Ch/0Dh = BX; waits for the next retrace (frame cadence tied to display refresh).

name: wait_vretrace
comment: Waits for the end then the start of vertical retrace (port 3DAh bit 3).

name: row_offset_table
comment: w[]; row*40 byte offsets into a mode 0Dh page.

name: sincos_deg
comment: AX = angle in degrees (wraps negatives once) -> [BX] = sin, [BX+2] = cos, Q15 from cos_table_q15.

name: atan_deg
comment: AX = ratio Q8 -> AX = angle 0..90 degrees (binary search of tan_table_q8).

name: approx_dist_points
comment: Approx 2D distance between [SI] and [DI] (x/y words); deltas saved at 3A92/3A94.

name: approx_dist_2d
comment: Approx sqrt(AX^2+BX^2): max*cos(t)+min*sin(t), t = 45*min/max degrees.

name: polar_to_delta
comment: SI->[heading,pitch], DX=distance: [DI]=d*sin(p), [DI+2]=h=d*cos(p) (unsigned mul!), [3261]=floor(h*cos(hd)/32768), [3263]=floor(h*sin(hd)/32768).

name: camera_matrix_from_angles
comment: SI -> yaw/pitch/roll (negated) -> cam_matrix 32B1 (3x3 Q15, saturating).

name: build_object_matrix
comment: SI -> 3 angles of a rotating object -> 3x3 Q15 at 330B (likely, same scheme as 3F2D).

name: mat_mul_object_camera
comment: Object matrix x cam_matrix -> obj_cam_matrix 331D (likely).

name: vec_mul_mat3
comment: [DI] = [SI] (3 w) times 3x3 Q15 matrix [BX] as row vector: sum of imul, <<1, high word.

name: xform_points_to_camera
comment: AX points at [BX]: subtract camera (points_rel_camera) then rotate by cam_matrix into 2286.

name: points_rel_camera
comment: [DI] = (y-cam.y, -(z-cam.z), x-cam.x) per point; camera space is X right, Y down, Z depth.

name: world_to_camera_point
comment: [SI] world point -> 344E camera space (rel to 2C71, rotated by cam_matrix).

name: build_axis_table
comment: Builds the 24 k*axis vectors at DS:3184 from 3 rotated axes (k=1 2 3 5 7 8 9 11).

name: unpack_vertices
comment: Packed vertex decoder (3 words per vertex: shift<<8 | signed selector into vertex_axis_table).

name: xform_packed_block
comment: BX = packed vertex block ({w x y z} origin + [3446] packed vertices): transform + project.

name: xform_plain_rotated
comment: BX = plain {x y z} list CX=count: rotated by obj_yaw (billboards) then projected.

name: project_vertices
comment: sx = (X<<8)/Z + view_cx, sy = (Y<<8)/Z + view_cy; Z<1 -> flag 2; idiv overflow (INT 0 -> 7FFF) -> 32-bit coords, flag 1.

name: project_points_simple
comment: Far: SI points at [BX] -> [DI] screen x,y using focal_len; no near/overflow handling.

name: project_points_simple_near
comment: Near-call copy of project_points_simple.

name: int00_div_overflow
comment: INT 0 handler: returns AX = 7FFF; if [ret] is F6/F7 (286 fault semantics) skips the 2-byte div.

name: install_int00
comment: Saves INT 0 (312A) and installs int00_div_overflow.

name: restore_int00
comment: Restores the saved INT 0 vector.

name: camera_from_car
comment: cam = car pos (2D35) + eye height 10 + 2CCF; chase offset 2C7D (helicopter view) via polar_to_delta; cam_bt_index2.

name: set_viewport
comment: SI = 7-word viewport descriptor copied to the variables listed at viewport_var_ptrs.

name: view_layout_dash
comment: Dash layout: viewport_desc_ptr = 3579, fullscreen_view = 0, [1A] = 2 (repaint static screen), clears gauge caches.

name: view_layout_full
comment: Full-screen layout: viewport_desc_ptr = 356B, fullscreen_view = FF.

name: toggle_fullscreen_view
comment: Toggles fullscreen_view and applies the layout.

name: draw_mirror_view
comment: Rear-view mirror: yaw+180 (or +-95 in side views), pitch negated, matrix column 0 negated, mirror_pass = FF, reduced cell window.

name: draw_view_border
comment: Line under the 3D viewport (DS:2B02 y=119 or DS:2B0B y=199) via draw_line.

name: model_unit_axes
comment: 9 w; (400 0 0)(0 -400 0)(0 0 400) in camera-input order; rotated into 316F each frame (3009:02EE).

name: viewport_desc_ptr
comment: w; main viewport descriptor (3579 dash view or 356B full screen).

name: fullscreen_view
comment: b; FF = full-screen 3D view (dash off).

name: viewport_var_ptrs
comment: 7 w; target addresses for set_viewport (315E 315A 3160 315C 316B 3169 316D).

name: viewport_mirror_r
comment: 7 w; mirror while looking right: x 80-127 y 96-119.

name: viewport_mirror_l
comment: 7 w; mirror while looking left: x 200-272 y 84-119.

name: viewport_mirror
comment: 7 w; rear-view mirror: x 192-319 y 0-35 centre (256 18).

name: view_top
comment: w; viewport top row.

name: view_bottom
comment: w; viewport bottom row.

name: view_left
comment: w; viewport left x.

name: view_right
comment: w; viewport right x.

name: focal_len
comment: w; 256. project_vertices hardcodes the same scale as <<8.

name: view_cx
comment: w; projection centre x.

name: view_cy
comment: w; projection centre y.

name: view_height
comment: w; 200/120/36 from the viewport descriptor (200 = full screen; tested by the frame loop).

name: view_axes
comment: 3x3 w; rotated world axes scaled to 1024 (vertex unpacking).

name: vertex_axis_table
comment: 24 x 3 w; k*axis vectors (k=1 2 3 5 7 8 9 11) for the 3 rotated model axes; built by 3009:39B9.

name: cam_matrix
comment: 3x3 w Q15 camera rotation (row-major).

name: obj_cam_matrix
comment: 3x3 w; object rotation x camera (rotated models; likely).

name: cam
comment: camera struct (car layout): +0 x +2 y +4 z +6 yaw +8 pitch +A roll +19 cell ptr +22 bt row +24 bt col +26 cell x +28 cell y.

name: cam_yaw
comment: w; degrees = car heading + view_yaw_offset.

name: cam_pitch
comment: w; degrees (from 2BEB).

name: cam_roll
comment: w; degrees.

name: chase_distance
comment: w; helicopter/chase camera distance (0 = in car; the mirror needs 0).

name: cam_bt_row
comment: w; camera big-tile row.

name: cam_bt_col
comment: w; camera big-tile column.

name: cam_cell_x
comment: w; camera cell x 0..15.

name: cam_cell_y
comment: w; camera cell y 0..15.

name: cam_cell_org_x
comment: w; camera x & F800h.

name: cam_cell_org_y
comment: w; camera y & F800h.

name: view_yaw_offset
comment: w; 0 front, +85 (55h) right, -85 left.

name: cam_bt_index2
comment: w; (cam_bt_row*map_cols + cam_bt_col)*2.

name: tan_table_q8
comment: 91 w; tan(0..90 deg) Q8 (89 deg = 7FFFh).

name: draw_world_cells
comment: Visits <=6 cells (2 ahead, 1 side row chosen by in-cell offset, own cell last) by heading sector; mirror_pass skips the far ones.

name: cell_lookup
comment: SI = car/camera struct: cell origin (2CC1/2CC3), in-cell offset (2CBF/2CBD), +26/+28 cell idx, +19 cell entry ptr.

name: draw_cell
comment: CX,DX = origin offset, BX,AX = cell offset: wraps big tiles, reads the cell entry, runs the static list, then sorted objects and vehicles.

name: draw_own_cell
comment: Camera's own cell: own_cell_pass = FF around draw_cell.

name: cell_m1_m1
comment: draw_cell helpers 35F0..371B: (CX,DX,BX,AX) = cell offsets; 36D4/36F0 use x origin 0FD0h instead of 1000h.

name: collect_sortables
comment: Copies cell list2 (absolute positions) plus the cell's vehicles into DS:35C5.

name: collect_vehicles
comment: List draw_vehlist: slots 0-2 (player, opponent, chase car) exact cell, others (cell&33h) match; writes the drawn cell back; own cell: collision test -> hit_vehicle_slot.

name: collect_pedestrians
comment: Pedestrian list draw_pedlist by (cell&33h); own cell in main view: collision test -> hit_pedestrian_slot.

name: cull_sortables
comment: Static sortables: keep -400h <= Z < 1400h and |X| < Z+600h; key Z-600h. Vehicles continue at 44D0.

name: cull_vehicles
comment: Vehicles: keep -80h <= Z < 1400h and |X| < Z+80h; key Z-80h (400h if <0); then sort.

name: sort_sortables
comment: Bubble sort of sortables by depth.

name: draw_sortables
comment: Calls each sorted record's draw routine with obj_pos set and obj_depth = its key; resets the 16-entry sort index DS:3805 from DS:37C5.

name: draw_compound_list
comment: Draws a compound structure list {code,dx,dy,dz}...FFFF (DS:A3E7) then sets compound_drawn.

name: draw_compound_list2
comment: Same for the compounds at 2C25 (A053) and 2C33 (A275).

name: draw_model_desc
comment: BX = model descriptor {b colour, w nverts, w poly, w verts, w extra list}: project and fill.

name: draw_road_quad
comment: 4-vertex flat quad in colour 8 (far/simple road piece).

name: draw_quad_block
comment: BX = packed block of a 4-vertex quad AL = colour: origin <- obj_pos then fill poly 6864.

name: mirror_pass
comment: b; FF while drawing the mirror (and in the 2AD4 mode): reduced cell window and inverted winding test. Menus reuse it.

name: buildings_off
comment: b; B key toggle: nonzero = building lists not drawn.

name: windows_off
comment: b; W key toggle (copy of cpu_slow_flag_b at race start): nonzero = downtown window faces (2E3C) not drawn.

name: mirror_off
comment: b; copy of cpu_slow_flag_a at race start; 0 = rear-view mirror drawn. Toggled at 0BA7.

name: compound_drawn
comment: w; FFFF after a multi-cell structure (2AA7/2C25/2C33) was drawn this frame.

name: cell_base_z
comment: w; elevation byte*224 of the cell being processed.

name: draw_cell_org_y
comment: w; world y origin of the cell being drawn.

name: draw_cell_org_x
comment: w; world x origin of the cell being drawn.

name: draw_cell_index
comment: w; x*16+y of the cell being drawn.

name: draw_cell_type
comment: w; cell type of the cell being drawn.

name: draw_cell_x
comment: w; cell x of the cell being drawn.

name: draw_cell_y
comment: w; cell y of the cell being drawn.

name: draw_cell_bt
comment: w; big-tile index*2 of the cell being drawn.

name: draw_vehlist
comment: w; bt_vehicle_lists entry for the big tile of the cell being drawn.

name: draw_pedlist
comment: w; bt_pedestrian_lists entry for the big tile of the cell being drawn.

name: facing_y_axis
comment: b; 0 = facing +-x, 1 = facing +-y (road models read it).

name: own_cell_pass
comment: b; FF while drawing the camera's own cell (collision tests run).

name: sortable_list
comment: {w code w x w y w z}... list2 objects + vehicles of the cell being drawn (3009:463E).

name: sort_keys
comment: w[]; depth keys of sortable_list.

name: sort_index
comment: w[16]; record offsets in draw order.

name: sort_index_init
comment: w[]; identity list copied to sort_index after each cell.

name: obj_pos
comment: 3 w; absolute x y z of the object being drawn (set before calling its routine).

name: hit_vehicle_slot
comment: w; byte offset in EF5A list of the vehicle hit in the render pass (0 = none).

name: hit_pedestrian_slot
comment: w; byte offset in EF8C list (-1 = none).

name: player_half_x
comment: w; player box half-extent x for the heading octant (from 2BC9).

name: player_half_y
comment: w; player box half-extent y for the heading octant (from 2BD9).

name: player_half_x_tab
comment: 8 w by heading octant (24,18,12,18,...).

name: player_half_y_tab
comment: 8 w by heading octant (12,18,24,18,...).

name: remote_car_drawn
comment: w; FFFF when vehicle slot 4 (other car) was drawn; read at D8B7.

name: obj_depth
comment: w (code seg); depth key of the sortable being drawn (Z-600h for list2 objects, Z-80h for vehicles); >= 800h selects the far LOD (set at 3009:4611).

name: faces5_visibility
comment: Face table of 5-byte {poly va vb colour}: visible iff (V[vb]-V[va]).V[va] > 0.

name: faces6_visibility
comment: Face table of 6-byte {poly v0 v1 v2 colour}: normal from 3 vertices.

name: faces5_draw
comment: Draws visible 5-byte faces (colour at +4).

name: faces6_draw
comment: Draws visible 6-byte faces (colour at +5).

name: fill_poly_list
comment: SI = {w n (n+1)*w idx*4}..FFFF AL=colour; vertex array 266E/1A86.

name: fill_poly_list_bx
comment: fill_poly_list without loading BX (jump table 9C72 entry 0).

name: poly_gather_clip
comment: Gathers projected vertices; if any flagged (proj_any_clipped) runs clip_near_plane and the 32-bit guard-band clips.

name: clip_near_plane
comment: Clips the polygon to Z = 1 in camera space (Q15 parameter) and projects the new vertices.

name: clip32_left
comment: Guard band: 32-bit x >= -4000h.

name: clip32_top
comment: Guard band: 32-bit y >= -4000h.

name: clip32_right
comment: Guard band: 32-bit x <= 4000h.

name: clip32_bottom
comment: Guard band: 32-bit y <= 4000h.

name: clip_viewport
comment: Sutherland-Hodgman against left/top/right/bottom (CX = vertices; 0 = rejected).

name: clip_left
comment: Clip to view_left.

name: clip_top
comment: Clip to view_top.

name: clip_right
comment: Clip to view_right.

name: clip_bottom
comment: Clip to view_bottom.

name: poly_winding_test
comment: 2D winding test when E0D4 set; sign inverted when mirror_pass (likely).

name: fill_spans
comment: EGA set/reset span fill (GC0 colour, GC1 0F, GC8 mask), 40-byte rows; high nibble != low -> dither pass.

name: fill_spans_solid
comment: Solid span loop (left table DS:002E right table DS:01BE).

name: fill_spans_dither
comment: Overlay of the high-nibble colour on a 55h/AAh checkerboard.

name: draw_line
comment: Line [SI]=x0,y0,x1,y1,b colour; self-modifying Bresenham (patches 52E4-5375, jumps via DS:38D8).

name: obj_vertex_count
comment: w; packed-vertex count for 3009:3879 (vertices = count+1).

name: obj_face_count
comment: b; face count for 3B78/3B0E/3BF5/3B43.

name: obj_face_table
comment: w; ptr to face table (5-byte {poly va vb colour} or 6-byte {poly v0 v1 v2 colour}).

name: obj_face_visible
comment: b[]; per-face visible flags written by 3B78/3BF5.

name: poly_colour
comment: b; low nibble = colour, high nibble = dither colour.

name: proj_verts
comment: 128 x 8 bytes {sx, sy, flags 0/1/2, cam vertex ptr}; 32-bit x,y at +400h.

name: cam_verts
comment: 6-byte camera-space vertices of the current model.

name: proj_any_clipped
comment: b; FF if any vertex of the model is behind Z=1 or overflowed.

name: draw_sky_ground_horizon
comment: Ground colour from bt_ground_colour (6 on the highway), horizon_line, fill_sky_ground, blit_horizon.

name: draw_sky_ground
comment: horizon_line + fill_sky_ground (mirror; no panorama).

name: horizon_line
comment: Projects (0, 25000*sin(pitch)+cam z, 25000): CX = horizon row clamped to the viewport; horizon_rows_hidden.

name: fill_sky_ground
comment: Set/reset fill: sky_colour from view_top to the horizon row, ground_colour down to view_bottom.

name: horizon_select
comment: SI = horizon slot offset for the camera's big tile.

name: blit_horizon
comment: 24 rows x 40 bytes from vram_store_seg at SI + heading + row*400 (8 px per degree), bottom on the horizon row.

name: vram_copy_rows
comment: EGA write mode 1 latch copy of BP rows x 40 bytes (source stride 400).

name: bt_index_5cols
comment: BX = (cam row*5 + col)*2 with a hard-coded 5 columns.

name: load_horizon_planes
comment: Copies a loaded HORIZONn.BIN (4 planes x 24 rows x 400 bytes) into vram_store_seg at DI, plane by plane.

name: sky_colour
comment: b; 0Bh.

name: ground_colour
comment: b; set per frame by draw_sky_ground_horizon.

name: bt_ground_colour
comment: 25 b; ground colour per big tile (7 land / 9 water); read by 3009:5A35.

name: bt_horizon
comment: 25 b; 0/2/4 -> horizon_offsets; indexed row*5+col with hard-coded 5 (3009:685E).

name: horizon_offsets
comment: 3 w; 0000/2580/4B00 = HORIZON0/1/2 slot in the horizon buffer (loaded by 3009:FE8F).

name: horizon_rows_hidden
comment: w; panorama rows hidden below the viewport bottom.

name: model_select_lod
comment: AX = id -> SI = model header from 245A:6FF8 (far header + colour patch when obj_depth >= 0x800).

name: draw_model
comment: Model header at SI: octant test (9CAF) -> skip list + face order; transform/project; per-face primitive via cs:9C72.

name: police
comment: highway mode (see re/notes/04-simulation-state.md) ----

name: player_step
comment: Per-frame player physics: 1EC8 engine+drivetrain, 1738 move, 21A2 speeding check. If DS:17!=0 copies 2F09 over 2D35 instead.

name: opponent_step
comment: Opponent car DS:2F09: 2P = serial packet or dead reckoning (speed/frame_rate, min 1); 1P = computer driver along waypoints FA22/F7C0.

name: police_step
comment: Police chase: spawns DS:3065 from the slot-3 patrol entity, pursues player (DS:2BA1), pulls over within 100 units, gives up at >=0xC00.

name: police_chase_reset
comment: Clears chase/siren/ticket state (F7C2 2B8F 2C59 2C5F 2C57 2C65 cs:DADD).

name: police_return_patrol
comment: Puts the slot-3 patrol entity back at the chase car position (cell of slot 2) with speed 0.

name: police_can_start_chase
comment: CF=0 -> start chase. Always CF=0 in F00C/F01E tiles; in F0B0/F0E6 tiles depends on patrol car side vs heading octant 2B89.

name: vehicle_move
comment: SI=vehicle struct. Player: collision handling 161A + steering/skid 4160:037F. Then 3CE7(heading,pitch,[si+20]) and x/y add with big-tile carry; cell update; z and pitch.

name: player_contact_response
comment: Handles render-pass hits: DS:2B7A (vehicle: speed -= speed>>profile[4]) and DS:2B7C (pedestrian: knock over, heading +-15, +100 to DS:2AD9). Sets offence bits.

name: vehicle_set_list_cell
comment: Writes cell index (cx*16+cy) of vehicle SI into slot [2B7E] of its big-tile EF5A list.

name: collide_cell_boxes
comment: BX=box list: tests the car's in-cell position against {xmin ymin xmax ymax} boxes; sets [2B20] side.

name: collision_box_event
comment: Dispatch on the address of the collision box hit: water (race ends), finish lines, highway on-ramps (DS:2AD4/8156), toll speed clamp, bridge-deck camera, rough surface; default 1BAB = wall crash.

name: car_contact_check
comment: Contact between SI and DI car (+-0x28 x, +-0x14 y, same big tile as camera) -> 1976 default crash path.

name: player_drivetrain
comment: 60D7 engine rpm then 4160:0939 autoshift then 4160:0045 drivetrain/speed.

name: ai_drivetrain
comment: 4160:0939 autoshift then 4160:04A7 AI speed model.

name: vehicle_face_target
comment: [si+6] = atan2 heading from vehicle (SI) to target point (DI).

name: gear_select
comment: AX = requested gear (manual). Too low for current speed -> neutral + grind + transmission damage, 2D51=1.

name: toggle_automatic
comment: Toggles DS:2D50 (player automatic gearbox flag).

name: race_setup_cars
comment: Copies player/opponent templates into 2D35/2F09, start position from DS:2D69[course-1], route list F7C0/FA22.

name: ai_route_load_targets
comment: Loads the 8-byte initial target from [FA22] into FA2C, next raw waypoint to FA24, builds FA34 via D150.

name: speeding_check
comment: speed - [2C4F] >= cs:219A[[3B61]] -> police alert 2C57=1, offence bit 0.

name: crash_damage
comment: Collision damage (needs FC4F!=0): speed<560 -> 2C5B+=1 (and 2C5D+=2 once 2C5B>=4); speed>=560 -> 2C5B=7, 2C5D+=6. Sets HUD damage message timer 3DEE = frame_rate*2.

name: heading_to_point
comment: Heading in degrees from (CX,DX) to (AX,BX); 0=+x 90=+y.

name: engine_rpm_update
comment: rpm = rev_acc / gear_div (cs:5877), clamped to idle (cs:5887) and redline (cs:586F, rev_acc-=4). Player: engine_speed = rpm.

name: hud_speed_value
comment: DS:3AA1 = ((speed>>2) + (speed>>3))>>1 (~speed*3/16, likely mph); bar length from it.

name: pedestrians_step
comment: EF8C list of camera big tile: walk square routes (speed +1/frame to 28), distance = speed/frame_rate, cell wraps mod 4; knocked-over ones reset when player is far.

name: traffic_step
comment: EF5A list of camera big tile from slot 3: accelerate per frame by profile stage, step = speed/frame_rate, follow route targets, intersection turns, move with cell carry.

name: traffic_accelerate
comment: speed += profile[6+2*stage] (per frame); cap profile[0E+2*stage], stage++ up to 3. Returns DX = speed/frame_rate.

name: traffic_move
comment: Moves entity by DX along +8 heading/+A pitch; wraps x/y 0..7FF and the list cell nibbles +-1 mod 16; shifts path targets by -+0x800.

name: traffic_follow_path
comment: If within step of target: target=next, new next from route via D150; heading = atan2 to target.

name: traffic_intersection
comment: Sets +1C moving flag; city tiles: byte map [[D2AE+bt*2]+cell] dispatched by heading quadrant through DS:EF52.

name: ped_speed_step
comment: Pedestrian speed +1/frame up to profile[0]; returns DX = speed/frame_rate.

name: ped_move
comment: Pedestrian move with cell wrap mod 4.

name: ped_follow_route
comment: Pedestrian waypoint following (accumulators +18/+1A vs route point).

name: ped_reset_if_far
comment: Restores a knocked-over pedestrian (EAEA->+10 profile) when >=2 cells (mod 4) from the player.

name: ai_path_plan
comment: Lane/turn planner: from target SI and raw waypoint DI builds next target at BX (8-direction switch via DS:FA4B).

name: opponent_throttle
comment: 1P opponent: brake if heading change ahead, speed>140 and dist [2B64] < 2.5*(speed-140); else full throttle.

name: opponent_finished
comment: Sets DS:FA45=FF and stores the finish time in cs:C9D4..C9D7.

name: highway_frame
comment: Highway mode (DS:2AD4!=0): build 32 road slices, advance/place 11 highway cars, spawn, exit countdown.

name: highway_exit
comment: DS:2AD4=0, 8411/8412=0, 2ABF=FF: back to city mode.

name: highway_draw_cars
comment: Draws the active highway cars (render only).

name: hw_polar_to_delta
comment: AX=heading, DX=distance: [3261]=-d*sin, [3263]=d*cos (highway frame).

name: hw_predict_contact
comment: Player vs highway car SI: ahead within 8 deg -> (v_player-v_car)/frame_rate vs gap; else side overlap test.

name: hw_player_collide
comment: Player vs 11 highway cars: on contact speed capped to lane speed DS:83E6[[814E]-1], rev_acc halved, crash damage.

name: hw_opponent_enter
comment: Computer opponent enters highway DS:81EC: init record 81CE.., speed from 2F17, DS:842B=FF.

name: hw_opponent_step
comment: Highway opponent per frame: 0314 (other highway) or 0664 lane AI + 08D6 (player's highway); step = [81DC]/frame_rate.

name: hw_opponent_exit
comment: Opponent leaves highway: DS:842B=0, 2F09 placed from DS:7572[id], next waypoint list.

name: hw_remote_place
comment: 2P: place remote car (DS:7406..) into highway slot 10 if near on the same highway.

name: hw_build_packet
comment: 2P highway packet: len 0x16 + FFFF + id/seg/pos/slice/dx/dy/heading/speed/flag.

name: hw_store_packet
comment: Copies received highway payload to DS:7406.

name: hw_remote_step
comment: 2P remote on highway without packet: dead reckoning, step = [7414]/frame_rate.

name: highway_enter
comment: Enter highway mode: player at (40A0,4000,7) heading 90, road id DS:8156, DS:2AD4=FF, exit delay 8412 = max(frame_rate-3,1).

name: hw_spawn_car
comment: Spawns a highway car (random lane/type) into a free DS:82F4 slot.

name: hw_car_advance
comment: BL = slot: advance (11C4: step = speed/frame_rate along slices), project for drawing.

name: vehicle_set_pitch
comment: BX = slope code from 4160:0515: [si+8] = DS:2B36[code][heading quadrant] (+-7 deg).

name: player_drivetrain_step
comment: Throttle (rev_acc += rate/fr w/ remainder), slope, brake/coast, engine coupling (speed += gap/4 per frame), [si+20] = (speed-2*slip)/frame_rate.

name: player_steer_skid
comment: Travel heading 2C45: skid when |steer|>=2 and speed >= grip DS:2BF1[model][|steer|] + bonus 4160:0373[model+4*level].

name: ai_speed_step
comment: AI speed: throttle += accel_tbl[gear]/fr (remainder +2E), coast -160/s; cap in top gear; [si+20] = speed/frame_rate.

name: ground_shape_height
comment: BX=shape class SI=pos: returns AX = in-cell height (0..E0) and BX = slope code; via DS:2B22.

name: car_cell_info
comment: From the car's cell word: [2CBB]=elev*224 and [2B14]/[2B16] = cell hdr lo/hi.

name: auto_shift
comment: Automatic gearbox (+1B): down below spd_tbl[gear-1] w/o throttle, up above spd_tbl[gear] w/ throttle; sets +1C.

name: player_wreck_check
comment: Damage 2C5D/2C4F >= 0x20/0x40 and stopped -> wrecked (2C6A); returns AL=FF 10 s later.

name: opponent_finish_estimate
comment: Same big tile: ticks = race_ticks + (dist/[2F29])*291/frame_rate.

name: serial_recv_packet
comment: Returns newest received packet (checksum verified) at DS=2F98:SI; ZF=1 if none.

name: serial_send_packet
comment: Sends packet at 2F98:015B (first word = length) with checksum.

name: player_speed
comment: w; units/s (world units). HUD ~ speed*3/16 (likely mph).

name: player_max_gear
comment: b

name: player_throttle

name: player_brake

name: player_automatic

name: player_step_dist
comment: w; distance moved this frame = speed/frame_rate.

name: player_rev_acc

name: player_rpm

comment: w

comment: w

comment: w; number of big-tile rows (5). Row index runs along world X (north).

name: coll_box_finish_c1

name: coll_box_finish_c2
comment: course 2 finish box (class 0F cell type 74; 3009:1B0D).

name: coll_box_finish_c3
comment: course 3 finish box (class 3B cell type 208; 3009:1B3F).

name: ground_shape_jt

comment: w; ground-shape class of the car's cell (cell hdr lo; 4160:0794).

comment: AX = data model id; yaw/pitch/roll [3226..322A] (vehicles).

comment: Sign of (V[i]-V[0]).V[0] for reference vertices 1..3.

comment: Sets on_diag_street from bt_street_set / cell_street_codes / in-cell position.

comment: Draws finish banner (block 6015) only when course==1 and sets [38D7]. 4798/47A8 = courses 2/3.

name: banner_start_c1
comment: Draws start banner (block 5F19) only when course==1. 47C8/47D8 = courses 2/3.

comment: b; race sound requests: bit1 skid (vehicle_move 1774), bit2 siren (police_step 1479), bit3 engine (frame loop 0156); bit0 one-shot lock (unused beeps).

name: snd_current
comment: b; request bit of the program playing (2 skid, 4 siren, 8 engine, 1 beep); 0 once a sequence ends.

name: engine_noise_on

name: snd_engine_last_speed

name: snd_seq_skid
comment: Skid warble: 501/462/481/501 Hz for 3/2/3/2 ticks, loop.

name: snd_seq_siren
comment: Siren: 659.6 Hz then 523.3 Hz, 28 ticks each, loop.

name: snd_seq_unused
comment: 36.4 Hz for 3 ticks in a loop; never played.

name: snd_engine_divisor
comment: w; the engine note's divisor (inside snd_seq_engine), slid by snd_engine_pitch_tick between 1400h and B000h.

name: snd_seq_beep_lo
comment: 659.6 Hz for 20 ticks; only snd_beep_lo (unused).

name: snd_seq_beep_hi
comment: 880.6 Hz for 10 ticks; only snd_beep_hi (unused).

name: snd_seq_win

name: snd_seq_title

name: snd_engine_resync_table
comment: 10 w; engine note divisor by engine_speed/8 (snd_engine_resync).

name: snd_play_title

name: snd_play_idle
comment: Plays snd_seq_idle. No caller.

name: snd_noise_crash
comment: Crash noise: 26 speaker clicks, on rand&7FF LOOPs then off 3100..5600 LOOPs; CPU-timed (0.12 s at 12 MHz). Only if sound_enabled == 1.

name: snd_noise_grind
comment: Gear grind: 41 clicks, on r = rand&3FF LOOPs then off r+10 (35 ms at 12 MHz). Only if sound_enabled == 1.

name: snd_request_dispatch
comment: Once per race frame (0165): plays the highest snd_request: skid > siren > engine.

name: snd_engine_resync
comment: Sound or engine noise back on: snd_engine_last_speed = engine_speed, divisor from snd_engine_resync_table.

name: snd_beep_lo
comment: Plays snd_seq_beep_lo with the one-shot lock. No caller.

name: snd_beep_hi
comment: Plays snd_seq_beep_hi with the one-shot lock. No caller.

name: random_seed
comment: w
